entities.summary: Stephan Vanfleteren (b. 1969, Kortrijk) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kortrijk and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, painters & sculptors, europe.
